research_notes: Follow up financial-institution names, role-specific dates, substantive full-time status and any leave; identify the 2008–2016 electorate-office employer. Seek historical bank records only after employers are verified.

Initial avenues 2026-09-29: APH biography, 2017/2020 handbooks, first speech, ALP biography, ABC 2022 guide, banking/employer/full-time searches and public LinkedIn lead. LinkedIn direct fetch returned 429; search index did not expose usable experience. Second search engine produced irrelevant employment results. No access controls bypassed.

ABC's over-30-years description is not converted into a duration or used to extend the official 1979–2008 range. Shares, loans or family financial interests do not identify her employer. Commonwealth Bank and St George search leads remain unverified, not facts.

APH also lists ALP electorate-council secretarial and conference-delegate roles with incomplete dates; these are excluded party activity, not assumed jobs. Banking, council and staff transitions within 2008 cannot be resolved from year-only dates. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; initial record is not completion.
